facts.business: Classic Filaments Limited is a company that underwent a complete change in promoter shareholding and management control during FY 2025-26, with the outgoing promoter group transferring its entire 68.51% equity stake to a new promoter.

auditor.name: Lakhankiya & Dosi LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on complete shift in promoter shareholding pattern and absolute transfer of management control (outgoing promoter transferred entire 68.51% equity stake to new promoter, leading to reconstitution of Board and KMP); and show-cause notice u/s 263 of Income Tax Act, 1961 for FY 2018-19 regarding alleged bogus purchases, which management considers valid and not materially impacting current financial results.

key_risks: Show-cause notice u/s 263 of Income Tax Act, 1961 for FY 2018-19 regarding alleged bogus purchases
Complete change in promoter shareholding and management control during the year
facts.related_party_note: Company has not advanced/loaned/invested to any person or entity with understanding that intermediary shall lend/invest in ultimate beneficiaries; Company has not received from any person or entity with understanding that company shall lend/invest in ultimate beneficiaries.
